title: Rest Client + Spring Di issue

labels.name: area/spring
labels.description: Issues relating to the Spring integration

body:
**Describe the bug**
Looks like there an issue to run the Rest Client with Spring Di.

The error can be reproduced using the rest-client project from quarkus-quickstarts.

CountriesResource:
```
@Path("/country")
public class CountriesResource {

//    @Inject
    @Autowired
    @RestClient
    CountriesService countriesService;


    @GET
    @Path("/name/{name}")
    @Produces(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
    public Set<Country> name(@PathParam("name") String name) {
        return countriesService.getByName(name);
    }

    @GET
    @Path("/name-async/{name}")
    @Produces(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
    public CompletionStage<Set<Country>> nameAsync(@PathParam("name") String name) {
        return countriesService.getByNameAsync(name);
    }
}
```
